yt_title: You will never watch your saved reels again
caption:
You will never watch your saved reels again. Unless you do this.

How to get your saved reels out of Instagram:
Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Some of your information → tick Saved → Format: HTML

Instagram emails you a zip. Drop it into SaveSort without unzipping it. It runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

My 156 saves: 30 worth doing, 10 straight-up hype, 22 hiding the steps behind "comment GUIDE".

Sort yours free, link in bio.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #aitools
